description: Oversvømmelsesdirektivet, OSD is a dataset listed in Datavejviser.dk, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Kystdirektoratet. Floods Directive (Directive 2007/60/EC on the assessment and management of flood risks). The objective of the Directive is to reduce the negative impact of floods by establishing guidelines for flood risk assessment and management. The Floods Directive is divided into three levels: 1. Coverage: Kystdirektoratet. The portal shows the English title as "Floods Directive, OSD" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Kystdirektoratet. Its keywords include HVD. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WEBSIDE. The listing shows 2026-09-23 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datavejviser.
